pages.text: The $(thing)Drying Rack$() has explicit hopper rules. Horizontal sides can insert valid raw leaves. The top and bottom cannot insert. The bottom can extract only when the batch has completely finished curing.

Rack automation still obeys batch rules: leaves must match the stored leaf's exact item/components, the rack holds at most 16, and insertion is blocked once progress reaches 10%. A hopper pulling from the bottom extracts only the requested amount rather than vacuuming the entire batch.
pages.title: Drying Rack

pages.text: The $(thing)Hookah$() exposes its three-slot item handler to NeoForge automation. Automated insertion is still validated per slot: fuel in slot 0, Shisha Tobacco in slot 1, and a Water Potion in slot 2.
pages.title: Hookah

pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacco Barrel$() exposes automation while still enforcing its normal batch rules. Valid cured or loose tobacco may be inserted when it matches the stored batch; extraction exposes the stored processed batch without discarding tobacco metadata. Manual right-click insertion/removal still works normally.
pages.title: Barrel
Other Processing Blocks
pages.text: The Drying Rack, Tobacco Barrel, Flue Firebox, and Hookah expose validated NeoForge item automation where appropriate. Automation never bypasses the blocks' normal input, batch, curing, fuel, or slot rules.
